question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is **'drew up'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's take a look at the** meaning** of the **options**:

 
 
• **drew off**: remove, withdraw.
 
• **drew down**: to deplete by using or spending.
 
• **drew up**: to prepare a draft or version of draw-up plans.
 
• **drew away: **to move away from a person or place.
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct answer is **option 3.**
